scenario: The ego car executes a U-turn at an intersection while an adversarial car passes straight through the crossing from the right.

ego.behavior: The car executes a U-turn at the intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car approaches from the right and passes straight through the crossing.

requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must spawn a set distance from the intersection, and the scenario terminates once the ego completes its U-turn and the adversarial car clears the crossing.
